brief: 5 soft boundaries that protect your peace without losing people.

slots.searchQuery: How to set soft boundaries without losing people

slots.body: Soft boundaries are not walls; they are bridges that keep connection alive while honoring your limits.
Wait before you answer any request. One breath buys you clarity and keeps resentment at bay.
Ask yourself what you truly need right now. Honesty with yourself is the first gentle boundary.
Offer only what you can give freely. A partial yes protects your peace better than a resentful no.
Guard the edges of your day like sacred ground. Availability is a gift, not an obligation.
Decline with warmth instead of over-explaining. A soft no preserves both your energy and the relationship.

slots.headline: Protect what restores you
slots.body: Pick one boundary to practice this week. Small shifts create the most lasting peace.
